scope: Coolgardie’s Shire publishes three candidates for one district councillor position with a term ending 16 October 2027. Nominations closed 20 October at 4 pm AWST. Completed postal voting packages must arrive by 6 pm AWST on 3 December. Checked 15 November.

sources.supports: Three candidate profiles and timetable. Exact ballot paper names were visually read from the three linked profile images.
Official nomination notice for one district councillor position with term expiry 16 October 2027.
Confirms Coolgardie proceeded to election and postal packages must be received by 6 pm AWST on 3 December.

limits: Displayed by surname. Formal ballot order and affiliations were not verified.
Supplied pictures and any contact details are excluded from the published data. No candidate is recorded as elected or serving because of this election.
